prompt: Create a realistic full-body street fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman standing outside a small urban cafe on a quiet sidewalk. She is posed in three-quarter side view with her body turned to the right and her face looking back toward the camera, smiling softly. She has long wavy dark brown-black hair with airy bangs, natural makeup, fair skin, and a slim silhouette. Outfit: a fitted ribbed cream white long-sleeve cropped sweater, a high-waisted dark gray pleated mini skirt, white mid-calf socks, and black leather loafers with small metal buckle details. Setting: white painted brick exterior wall, black-framed glass cafe entrance on the right, warm pendant lights visible inside, a black rectangular hanging sign above the door reading CORNER CAFE / COFFEE & PASTRIES, and one potted green shrub in a gray concrete planter on the left. Use soft natural daylight, gentle shadows on the pavement, shallow depth of field, muted modern city tones, crisp fabric texture, realistic skin detail, and an editorial lifestyle photography look. Vertical 2:3 composition, subject centered slightly left, full body visible from head to shoes, no extra people, no watermark, no distorted anatomy.

promptZh: 创作一张写实的全身街头时尚人像，画面中一位年轻的东亚女性站在安静人行道旁的一家小型城市咖啡馆外。她呈四分之三侧身姿势，身体向右转，脸部回眸看向镜头，面带柔和微笑。她留着长波浪卷发，带有空气刘海，妆容自然，肤色白皙，身材苗条。服装：一件修身罗纹 奶油白 长袖短款毛衣、一条高腰深灰色百褶迷你裙、白色中筒袜以及带有金属小扣细节的黑色皮质乐福鞋。场景：白色漆面砖墙，右侧为黑色边框的玻璃咖啡馆入口，室内可见温暖的吊灯，门上方挂着一块黑色长方形招牌，上面写着 CORNER CAFE / COFFEE & PASTRIES，左侧有一个灰色混凝土花盆，里面种着一株绿色灌木。使用柔和的自然日光，人行道上有轻柔的阴影，浅景深，低饱和度的现代城市色调，清晰的织物纹理，真实的皮肤细节，以及编辑类生活方式摄影风格。竖版 2:3 构图，主体略微偏左居中，全身从头到鞋可见，无其他人物，无水印，无解剖结构畸变。
